content1.content: 🚀 Flutter App Structure: A Complete Beginner's Guide

content2.content: 🧠 What is Flutter App Structure & Why It Matters?

content4.content: The Flutter App Structure is like the layout of your house — it tells Flutter where things go (widgets, screens, assets) and how they work together.

content6.content:
Think of building an app like building a house:
🧱 Widgets :-> Bricks (UI elements)
🗂️ Folders/files :-> Rooms and cabinets (organized layout)
🧭 Navigation :-> Hallways (moving between rooms)
🔧 Main.dart :-> The entry gate (where your app starts)
Without structure, everything is chaos.

row2: The starting point of the app
row3: A widget that sets up the app with themes, routes, etc.
row4: A base layout for screens with app bar, body, etc.
row5: The building blocks of the UI
row7: UI that changes based on user interaction

content11.content:
Everything in Flutter is a widget
Widgets are nested (tree structure)
Keep code modular: use separate files and folders for better maintainability

content13.content:
lib/
├── main.dart       --> App entry point
├── screens/        --> Different screens/pages
├── widgets/        --> Reusable UI components
├── models/         --> Data models (if any)
├── services/       --> Business logic/API calls
├── assets/         --> Images/fonts (declared in pubspec.yaml)

content15.content:
Multi-screen navigation
Reusable UI components (buttons, cards)
Organized data with models and services
Scalable apps with maintainable structure

content18.content:
Install [Flutter SDK](https://flutter.dev/docs/get-started/install)
Install [VS Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/) or Android Studio
Run `flutter doctor` to verify setup
Create project:
flutter create my_app
cd my_app

content20.content:
Update your `lib/` folder:

lib/
├── main.dart
├── screens/
│   └── home_screen.dart
├── widgets/
│   └── custom_button.dart

content30.content:
A well-structured app = easier to scale and maintain
Use folders to separate responsibilities (screens, widgets, etc.)
Understand the widget tree and navigation flow
Practice reusing widgets instead of repeating code
